symptom: ako/mxcli#2034: ARCH001 'references entity from module System' fired on the System.WorkflowUserTask data view of every workflow task page and on a task inbox over System.WorkflowUserTask; in ako/ChatV2 three such warnings dropped the Architecture score from 82 to 58 with nothing to act on.
cause: cross_module_data.star treated every entity outside the widget's module as cross-module coupling, including the platform's workflow API.
insight: A lint rule's advice must have a way out: Mendix requires System.WorkflowUserTask/System.Workflow data containers (CE7410/CE7412, CE1843), so a warning there can only be suppressed, never fixed. Check a rule against the templates the skills ship before trusting a score built on it.
